items.source: Optional ResultSetExtractor to use to convert the result of the query to domain class instances.
items.translation: 可选的 ResultSetExtractor，用于将查询结果转换为领域类实例。

items.source: Optional name of a bean of type ResultSetExtractor to use to convert the result of the query to domain class instances.
items.translation: 可选的 Bean 名称，类型为ResultSetExtractor，用于将查询结果转换为领域类实例。

items.source: Optional RowMapper to use to convert the result of the query to domain class instances.
items.translation: 可选的 RowMapper，用于将查询结果转换为领域类实例。

items.source: Optional name of a bean of type RowMapper to use to convert the result of the query to domain class instances.
items.translation: 可选的 Bean 名称，其类型为RowMapper，用于将查询结果转换为领域类实例。

items.source: The SQL statement to execute when the annotated method gets invoked.
items.translation: 当注解的方法被调用时执行的 SQL 语句。

items.source: You can also specify the way to extract data from ResultSet. There are 4 attribute of this annotation you can set to do that:
items.translation: 您还可以指定从ResultSet中提取数据的方式。该注解有 4 个属性可供设置以实现此功能：

items.source: The named query to be used. If not defined, the name of ${domainClass}.${queryMethodName} will be used.
items.translation: 要使用的命名查询。如果未定义，将使用 ${domainClass}.${queryMethodName} 的名称。

items.source: The named query to be used.
Jens Schauder, Moises Cisneros, Hebert Coelho, Mikhail Polivakha

Annotation to provide SQL statements that will get used for executing the method. The SQL statement may contain named parameters as supported by NamedParameterJdbcTemplate. Those parameters will get bound to the arguments of the annotated method.
items.translation: 注解用于提供将用于执行该方法的 SQL 语句。该 SQL 语句可以包含由 NamedParameterJdbcTemplate 支持的命名参数。这些参数将被绑定到注解方法的参数。

items.source:
1. resultSetExtractorRef()
  2. resultSetExtractorClass()
  3. rowMapperRef()
  4. rowMapperClass()
The annotation attributes above are listed in their preference order, that is - the resultSetExtractorRef(), has the highest privilege and, will suppress any other 3 attribute from above, and consequently rowMapperClass() has the lowest privilege and will be used if any of three above are not specified.
items.translation:
1. resultSetExtractorRef()
  2. resultSetExtractorClass()
  3. rowMapperRef()
  4. rowMapperClass()
上述注解属性按其优先级顺序列出，即 resultSetExtractorRef() 具有最高优先级，并将抑制上述其他三个属性；因此，rowMapperClass() 具有最低优先级，仅当上述三个属性均未指定时才使用。
